name: Pizzeria Montana
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Montana in Tirol**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps! **Pizzeria Montana** invites you to savor delicious wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta, and crisp salads in a cozy mountain setting. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Tiroler Speck** pizza, every bite is crafted with care.

After your meal, warm up with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or enjoy a rich **Apfelstrudel** for dessert. The rustic ambiance and panoramic views of the surrounding peaks make this the perfect spot for a relaxed yet unforgettable dining experience.

Located near **Innsbruck**, **Pizzeria Montana** is your go-to for a taste of Italy with a **Tirol** twist. Come for the food, stay for the atmosphere!
